# Governance Hooks

These markdown hooks define required policy checks when executable hooks are not configured.

## Hook Budget And Activation
- Keep blocking hooks small and high-signal to reduce overhead.
- Prefer instructions for broad standards and prompts/skills for workflow guidance.
- Use non-blocking checklist documents for secondary checks.

## Blocking Hooks (Primary)
- pre-implementation-planning-check.md
- git-safety-check.md
- architecture-boundary-check.md
- test-completeness-check.md

## Non-Blocking Checklist
- non-blocking-checklists.md
